+import re
+
+
+def count_words(sentence: str) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Count occurrences of each word in a subtitle.
+
+    Words are case-insensitive, contractions count as single words,
+    numbers count as words, and punctuation separates words.
+    """
+    # Normalize case and split on any non-alphanumeric character except apostrophes
+    # that are part of contractions. Use a regex that keeps apostrophes within words.
+    words = re.findall(r"[a-z]+(?:'[a-z]+)?|[0-9]+", sentence.lower())
+    counts = {}
+    for word in words:
+        counts[word] = counts.get(word, 0) + 1
+    return counts
